description: Turn purchase intent into a proposed DRAFT Spool (the agreement object) with explicit acceptance criteria and earned-value rules. Use before both parties confirm terms; do not use for one-call unilateral result verification. This creates a persisted draft to inspect, then accept_spool confirms it, amend_spool changes conditions or unitization, and abandon_spool discards it. Works in the no-key sandbox.
name: compile_spool
title: Spool draft
